title: Coldridge Pass
wikitext:
[[Image:Coldridge Pass.jpg|thumb|300px|Coldridge Pass, Coldridge Valley side.]]
'''Coldridge Pass''' links [[Coldridge Valley]] to the rest of [[Dun Morogh]], and is crucial to give the trickle of dwarven and gnomish recruits to the frontier town of [[Kharanos]]. Unfortunately, the pass has recently become infested with [[trogg]]s, and the only chance for travelers to get through is either to run at top speed or slash their way through the hostile invaders.
